assumptions: Field labels (holder offsets, node size, next offset) describe observed pointer arithmetic only, not confirmed source-level types.
Sized-delete sizes are the second argument observed at each PLT call site.
The begin == holder+0x30 comparison is recorded as an observed branch condition; calling that address inline storage is an inference, not a pinned fact.
The list is treated as a well-formed null-terminated chain; a cyclic or corrupt chain is not modelled.
behavior: List teardown followed by a buffer clear: drain the linked list at holder+0x10 (nodes are 0x18 bytes, next pointer at +0x00, next loaded before each sized delete of 0x18 through the _ZdlPvm PLT at 0x63f0d80), then memset the buffer at holder+0x00 with size [holder+0x08] * 8, zero holder+0x10 and holder+0x18, and return plainly when the reloaded begin equals holder+0x30, otherwise tail-jump to the sized-delete PLT freeing (begin, [holder+0x08] * 8). Writes nothing else to the holder, never frees the holder itself, never clears holder+0x00 or holder+0x08, performs no canary check.

buffer_phase.exit_condition: reloaded begin == holder+0x30 returns plainly, otherwise tail-jump sized delete

consumers.note: Reached only by code, never by data. See callers.tsv for the site list.
